leadText: Volume 23 is the twenty-third volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the second of five volumes in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.
plainText:
Volume 23 is the twenty-third volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the second of five volumes in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

==Blurb==
Just as Green is about to meet her long-lost parents, they are sucked into a vortex created by a mysterious Pokémon! Red and Blue want to help, but first they must improve their battle skills. Then, the Three Beasts of Team Rocket are up to their old tricks again!

Which former enemy will unexpectedly come to our friends’ aid...?

==Publications==

Chapter 269: Return to Pallet Town 
Chapter 270: Now You See Me...

Chapter 273: Red and Blue Make Purple Opponents

Chapter 275: A Vicious Cycle of Possibilities
Chapter 276: My, My, My Mimic
Chapter 277: A Beastly Cold Reception
Chapter 278: Put Your Beast Foot Forward
Chapter 279: Don't Doubt Deoxys

==Important events==
 
and 's escape from Masked Man's lair two years before the is shown. 
and return to Pallet Town and are attacked by an . 
Red and Blue leave their Pokédexes at 's laboratory and leave for Vermilion City.
Green is about to meet her parents, but the two are snagged by a mysterious shadow. She falls unconscious.
Ultima appears and takes Red and Blue to the Sevii Islands.
Red's Saur and Blue's Charizard learn and , respectively.
Lorelei reappears.
Sird, Carr, and Orm appear.
The Three Beasts defame the Pokédex holders and start wreaking havoc on the Five, Six, and Seven Islands. 
It is revealed that Professor Oak has been kidnapped.
Red begins to battle Deoxys.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
None.
===Evolutions===
None.

==Trivia==
This issue has connecting cover art with the next two volumes.
